value.rationale: The six-state case is the endpoint of the defining fixed-alphabet small-state investigation, and the result upgrades a reset threshold to the full one-letter composition statistics of all optimal controls. The universal absence of \(b\) from every shortest word is a structural statement not supplied by the existence proof.

final_claim: For the six-state five-letter de Bondt--Don--Zantema automaton, every shortest reset word has length 20 and resets to state 3, there are exactly \(452984832=2^{24}3^3\) such words, none uses letter \(b\), and the five one-letter marginal generating functions are exactly those displayed in RESULT.md.
limitations: Finite exact result for the six-state specialization only; no arbitrary-n marginal factorization is claimed.
